description: The chart is a bar chart illustrating the results of an ablation study, comparing the performance of different models or methods. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled with various ablation settings, including "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from an unspecified lower limit to an upper limit, with a linear scale. The bars are grouped by dataset, with two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact, represented by separate bars for each ablation setting. The bars for each dataset are colored differently, although the exact colors are not specified. The accuracy values for PHEME range from approximately 80.10% to 89.84%, with the highest value corresponding to the "DAE (Ours)" or full model, while the values for PolitiFact range from around 83.02% to 90.57%, also with the highest value corresponding to the full model. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, but the ablation settings are listed in a consistent order for both datasets. No bars are visually emphasized.
